title_vi: Năm mẫu kiến trúc hàng đầu: nguồn không nêu tên, nên bài đo năm lựa chọn mà mọi kiểu đều đẩy cho bạn

claims.evidence: Source body read at the pinned commit: three introductory paragraphs and a picture; the text names no pattern (the picture was not used), so the five patterns of the picture are not covered. Style table, challenges, retry and circuit-breaker statements read from local clones of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at 8e2c239. Five choices measured by Python 3.13.16 programs on a 4-vCPU virtual machine on 2026-10-19 (three runs for the general measurements, two for the retry measurement). The circuit breaker is a simplified closed/open breaker with a 1-second reset timer written for the lesson; the measurements ended before the timer expired so recovery was not tested. The five choices are the author's framing, not the source's content.

claims.claim_vi: Source: architecture shapes the structure and behaviour of software systems and is a blueprint of how components interact; patterns offer solutions to common problems, saving time and effort and leading to more robust and maintainable systems; with the vast array of styles and patterns it can be hard to tell which suits a project, so a cheat sheet summarises the main characteristics of each. The text names no pattern.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft architecture styles: a style is a family of architectures sharing characteristics and places constraints on the design; the table lists N-tier, Web-Queue-Worker, Microservices, Event-driven, Big data and Big compute with dependency management and suitable domains (web-queue-worker decouples front end and back end jobs by asynchronous messaging; big compute allocates data to many cores); challenges named are complexity, asynchronous messaging and eventual consistency, interservice communication overhead causing latency, and manageability.
claims.section: Architecture styles as constraints; Consider challenges and benefits
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft retry and circuit breaker: the retry pattern handles transient faults by retrying, with increasing delays, and warns to consider whether an operation is idempotent; the circuit breaker temporarily blocks calls after failures reach a threshold instead of repeatedly retrying an operation likely to fail, and serves a different purpose than retry (retry expects eventual success, the breaker prevents calls that are likely to fail).
claims.verified_by: Read from local clones (retry-content.md and circuit-breaker.md) at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Experiment (ranges are min to max over three runs, two for retry): 50 waits of 20 ms take 1.008-1.010 s one after another and 0.022 s with asyncio, but 20,000 tiny no-wait tasks take 0.0035-0.0047 s as plain calls and 0.11-0.16 s as asyncio tasks; a CPU job with a 0.05 s serial part on 4 vCPUs is 1.5-2.05 times faster with 2 processes and 1.95-2.53 times with 4; three REST calls (4083 bytes) take 683-775 us versus one query for the needed fields (354 bytes) 223-246 us; reading one customer's 200 orders takes 183-215 us with a join and 182-279 us from a flat table, renaming a customer takes 3 us normalized versus 98-143 us flat (200 rows), storage 2,609,152 bytes versus 6,754,304; a dependency answering after 200 ms: 20 of 20 succeed in 4.04 s without a timeout, 0 of 20 in 1.01 s with a 50 ms timeout, 0 of 20 in 0.25 s with a breaker and the server sees 5 calls instead of 20; with 30% failures 1416 of 2000 succeed without retry and 1936 with up to 3 attempts (2792 server calls); when down, 500 calls with up to 3 attempts reach the server 1500 times, with a breaker 5 times.
claims.verified_by: Programs run by the author on 2026-10-19; services are threads in one process reached over local HTTP.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: năm lựa chọn, năm phép đo, giới hạn; nhấn rằng nguồn không nêu tên năm mẫu.
source_deviations: The source text names no pattern; the five patterns are in its picture, which this lesson did not use. The lesson therefore does not claim to cover them and frames five design choices of its own.
The cheat sheet of the source is replaced by Microsoft's table of architecture styles.
